findings.quote: Earth's rotation makes the stars seem to circle around them. Precession, below, explains more.
findings.problem: The round-6 fix added the south celestial pole sentence to the celestial-pole paragraph, which now has four sentences ('The **north celestial pole** is ...', 'The **south celestial pole** is ...', this one, and 'Precession, below, explains more.'). The limit is one to three short sentences. The round-6 split of the two paragraphs round 5 named is otherwise done.
